{{Infobox auto}}

A '''braised toadstool''' is a cooked red [[mushroom]], the simple preparation of the toadstool. It heals {{Value|Braised Toadstool|heals}} but gives the eater {{EffectLink|Poison}} for {{Value|Braised Toadstool|duration|effect=Poison}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/braised_red_mushroom.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
A red mushroom cooks into a braised toadstool in an [[oven]] or on [[kindling]] in {{Value|Braised Toadstool|cook_time}}. Picking up a red mushroom unlocks the oven recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating a braised toadstool takes {{Value|Braised Toadstool|eat_time}}, heals {{Value|Braised Toadstool|heals}} and gives Poison {{Value|Braised Toadstool|level|effect=Poison}} for {{Value|Braised Toadstool|duration|effect=Poison|format=clock}}.

Obtaining a braised toadstool unlocks [[Pickled Toadstools|pickled toadstools]] and [[Toadstool Stroganoff|toadstool stroganoff]], which are made from raw red mushrooms.

== Advancements ==
* ''Powerful Flavors'': cook an intrinsic ingredient. Obtaining any of the 11 simple preparations of the ordinary intrinsic ingredients completes it.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/tutorial/cook_food.json}}</ref>
